Flywire Charitable Foundation Scholarships 2023 is an opportunity offered by the Flywire Charitable Foundation (a global payments enablement and software company) to undergraduate students. The scholarship program aims to improve equality, access, and affordability for underrepresented individuals and communities. A total of 16 candidates will be selected for the scholarship and receive a one-time compensation of USD 5,000 for the selected four themes.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be 18 years and above in age
be enrolled for the 2023 fall semester
Note - Funds cannot be deferred for future terms/semesters.
Selected students will receive a one-time compensation of USD 5,000 for selected four themes.

Note - Winners will be notified via the email provided by Friday, July 21st.

A select committee of Flywire Charitable Foundation members and diverse global Flywire employees will review each application individually. The following criteria will be taken into consideration for selection:
The applicant meets all requirements, clearly addresses the questions posed by Flywire and demonstrates how their studies relate to the scholarship they have selected.
The applicant provides a clear overview of their personality, interests and values and shows evidence of determination and resilience when faced with obstacles.
The applicant describes their personal, academic and/or career goals and indicates how their educational pursuits are helping them achieve stated goals.
Each student can only apply to one of the four scholarship categories.
Scholarship funds will be directly deposited into the institution’s account.

Source of Information: Buddy4Study app compiles details on scholarships/fellowships from government websites and private scholarship sources. Links to the official sources accompany each listing detail pages.
